asChild.description:
Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

Use `render` when you need the part's state. It takes the same props function, plus the state.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

collapsible.description: Whether an accordion item can be closed after it has been expanded.

defaultValue.description:
The initial value of the expanded accordion items.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the accordion.

disabled.description: Whether the accordion items are disabled

hiddenUntilFound.description:
Whether closed items stay searchable with the browser's find-in-page.
Uses `hidden="until-found"`, and expands an item when a match is found inside it.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the accordion. Useful for composition.

multiple.description: Whether multiple accordion items can be expanded at the same time.

onFocusChange.description: The callback fired when the focused accordion item changes.

onValueChange.description: The callback fired when the state of expanded/collapsed accordion items changes.

orientation.description: The orientation of the accordion items.
